an1.41:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave sālisūkaṃ vā yavasūkaṃ vā micchā paṇihitaṃ hatthena vā pādena vā akkantaṃ hatthaṃ vā pādaṃ vā bhecchati lohitaṃ vā uppādessatī ti. N' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an1.41:1.4: eva kho bhikkhave so vata bhikkhu micchā paṇihitena cittena avijjaṃ bhecchati vijjaṃ uppādessati nibbānaṃ sacchikarissatī ti. N' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an1.42:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave sālisūkaṃ vā yavasūkaṃ vā sammā paṇihitaṃ hatthena vā pādena vā akkantaṃ hatthaṃ vā pādaṃ vā bhecchati lohitaṃ vā uppādessatī ti. Ṭhānaṃ etaṃ vijjati.
an1.42:1.4: eva kho bhikkhave so vata bhikkhu sammā paṇihitena cittena avijjaṃ bhecchati vijjaṃ uppādessati nibbānaṃ sacchikarissatī ti. Ṭhānaṃ etaṃ vijjati.
an1.43:1.1: Idhāhaṃ bhikkhave ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ paduṭṭhacittaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi.
an1.43:1.2: Imamhi ce ayaṃ samaye puggalo kālaṃ kareyya yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an1.43:1.5: Ceto-padosa-hetucca pana bhikkhave evam idh' ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ uppajjantī
an1.44:1.1: Idhāhaṃ bhikkhave ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ pasannacittaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi.
an1.44:1.2: Imamhi ce ayaṃ samaye puggalo kālaṃ kareyya yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
an1.44:1.5: Ceto-pasāda-hetucca pana bhikkhave evam idh' ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjantī
an1.45:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave udakarahado āvilo luḷito kalalībhūto tattha cakkhumā puriso tīre ṭhito na passeyya sippisambukam pi sakkharakaṭhalam pi maccha-gumbam pi carantam pi tiṭṭhantam pi.
an1.45:1.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave so vata bhikkhu āvilena cittena attatthaṃ vā ñassati paratthaṃ vā ñassati ubhayatthaṃ vā ñassati uttariṃ vā manussadhammā alamariyañāṇa-dassanavisesaṃ sacchikarissatī ti. N' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an1.46:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave udakarahado accho vippasanno anāvilo tattha cakkhumā puriso tīre ṭhito passeyya sippisambukam pi sakkhara-kaṭhalam pi macchagumbam pi carantam pi tiṭṭhantam pi.
an1.46:1.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave so vata bhikkhu anāvilena cittena attatthaṃ vā ñassati paratthaṃ vā ñassati ubhayatthaṃ vā ñassati uttarim vā manussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ sacchikarissatī ti. Ṭhānaṃ etaṃ vijjati.
an1.47:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yāni kānici rukkhajātāni candano tesaṃ aggam akkhāyati yadidaṃ mudutāya kammaññatāya, evaṃ
an1.47:1.2: eva kho ahaṃ bhikkhave na aññaṃ ekadhammam pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ mudu ca hoti kammaññañ ca yathayidaṃ cittaṃ.
an1.47:1.3: Cittaṃ bhikkhave bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ mudu ca hoti kammaññañ cā
an1.48:1.1: Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammam pi samanupassāmiyaṃ evaṃ lahuparivattaṃ yathayidaṃ cittaṃ
an1.48:1.2: yāvañ c' idaṃ bhikkhave upamā pi na sukarā yāva lahuparivattaṃ cittan ti. 9.
an1.49:1.2: tañ ca kho āgantukehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhan ti. 10.
